name: Carrier
author: E. T. Carter
description: A rack of horizontal waveform traces, each a thin phosphor line with a soft glow halo, displaced by exact sums of sinusoids. Channels scroll laterally at a steady reading pace while slow envelopes swell, frequencies glide, and beats walk — patient radio traffic after midnight, ruled and precise, looping on a shared ~60s super-period.

params.label: Row gap
params.effect: Vertical distance between channel baselines in CSS pixels — pack a dense rack of signals or spread a few wide-open traces.

params.label: Signal speed
params.effect: Scales both the lateral scroll and the modulation clocks, from barely-moving standing waves to briskly streaming telemetry.

params.label: Modulation depth
params.effect: How far envelopes swell and frequencies glide — flat steady carriers at 0, dramatically breathing and bending signals at 1.

params.label: Line count
params.effect: How many channel traces fill the rack — a lone signal at 1, a dense stacked monitor at 14 (paired with row gap to set the packing).

params.label: Distortion
params.effect: Inharmonic high-frequency grit roughening the traces — 0 is the pristine ruled waveform, high frays each line into a gritty, unstable signal.
